# Elite Performance Center

> Indoor, air-conditioned baseball and softball training facility in Clovis, California. Batting lanes with pitching machines, private lessons, HitTrax swing data, memberships, and team rentals for players from Clovis and Fresno.

Draft for launch: publish at the root of the final domain as /llms.txt and update the URLs below to the final page addresses.

## Key facts

- Address: 906 Barstow Ave, Suite A, Clovis, CA 93612
- Phone: (559) 274-2130
- Email: info@eliteperformancecenterca.com
- Hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 3 PM to 9 PM; Wednesday 2 PM to 9 PM; Saturday 11 AM to 4 PM; Sunday closed
- Booking: https://eliteperformancecenterca.ezfacility.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eliteperformancecenter_clovis/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61594280009550

## Services and rates

- Baseball and softball batting lanes with pitching machines: $40 per hour, up to four players, $10 per additional player
- Single membership: $250 per month, one hour of hitting per day, subject to availability
- Team membership: $600 per month, whole facility one day per week for two hours
- HitTrax: $85 per person, $20 per additional person, up to four
- Private one-on-one lessons: rates and coach availability on request
- Team and group rentals: single lane up to the whole facility, up to six cages
